sn48.23:1.3: Found at [dn33:1.10.111]() and [iti62:2.3](), this went on to become a standard Abhidhamma set. | “The faculty of understanding that one’s enlightenment is imminent” is literally, “The faculty aware that ‘I shall know the unknown’.” | The verses at [iti162](), though not entirely clear, help explain the meaning, which, however, seems in tension with the commentarial explanation.
